content.comment_body: When starting [product_name] software [version_no], previous files are opened automatically. How can I disable this feature? Thanks.

Hello! I'm not certain if this is the official solution, but if you close the project first and then exit the software, it shouldn't reopen old projects automatically. If you close the program with a project still open, the same project will reopen when you next launch the software. [user_name]
That's correct, as mentioned above. Close all open projects first, then [product_name] software will start with an empty or blank screen.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience their previous project files reopening automatically when launching the software, which some find inconvenient. There is confusion regarding how to modify this behavior or if a direct option exists, resulting in users suggesting manual closing of projects before exiting. This points to limited user configuration and interface clarity in the product.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to include a setting allowing startup with a blank screen and the ability to turn off automatic reopening of previous files.
